verdict.rationale:
OpenHands' core loop is exactly this: users type natural-language tasks and the agent works toward them (docs-1, docs-24), and dedicated automations turn incoming bug/issue signals and PR review requests directly into implementation tasks or fix PRs (docs-7, docs-9, docs-10). A dedicated planning agent example (docs-28) further shows task-scoping behavior built into the SDK.
Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of an automatic 'plain language → scoped spec/task breakdown' step (vs. just execution), and independent/hands-on verification of task quality.
